Assumptions & Decisions

Assumptions:

* Keeping the conditionals as structured if/then nodes, and letting the interpolation stay as raw string syntax instead of structured expression objects.  
* Storing the assignments as one ordered flat array instead of grouping it by keys.

Decisions:

* Initially the hand-picked the environment fixtures from the files, later optimised it by changing them into auto-derived ones.  
* A few of the decisions which I had almost low-to-no idea about certain things like, whether to save the auto-generated env files, or freshly generate them each time, etc; I left it to the AI model to be the decision maker.
